ayahs.2: Yeh ek kitaab hai jo aap ke paas is liye bheji gayi hai ke aap is ke zariye se daraayen, so aap ke dil mein is se bilkul tangi na ho aur naseehat hai imaan walon ke liye.
ayahs.3: Tum log us ka itteba karo jo tumhare Rabb ki taraf se aayi hai aur Allah Taala ko chhod kar manghadat sarparaston ki itteba mat karo. Tum log bahut hi kam naseehat pakadte ho.
ayahs.4: Aur bahut bastiyon ko hum ne tabaah kar diya aur un par hamara azaab raat ke waqt pahuncha ya aisi haalat mein ke woh dopahar ke waqt aaraam mein the.
ayahs.5: So jis waqt un par hamara azaab aaya us waqt un ke munh se bajuz is ke aur koi baat na nikli ke waqai hum zaalim the.
ayahs.6: Phir hum un logon se zaroor poochhenge jin ke paas paighambar bheje gaye the aur hum paighambaron se zaroor poochhenge.
ayahs.7: Phir hum chunke poori khabar rakhte hain un ke rubaroo bayaan kar denge. Aur hum kuch be-khabar na the.
ayahs.8: Aur us roz wazan bhi barhaq hai phir jis shakhs ka palla bhaari hoga so aise log kaamyaab honge.
ayahs.9: Aur jis shakhs ka palla halka hoga so yeh woh log honge jinhon ne apna nuqsaan kar liya ba-sabab is ke ke hamari aayaton ke saath zulm karte the.
ayahs.10: Aur be-shak hum ne tum ko zameen par rehne ki jagah di aur hum ne tumhare liye is mein saamaan-e-rizq paida kiya, tum log bahut hi kam shukr karte ho.
ayahs.11: Aur hum ne tum ko paida kiya, phir hum hi ne tumhari soorat banaayi phir hum ne farishton se kaha ke Aadam ko sajda karo so sab ne sajda kiya bajuz Iblees ke, woh sajda karne walon mein shaamil na hua.
ayahs.12: Haq Taala ne farmaya tu jo sajda nahi karta to tujh ko is se kaun amr maane hai, jabke main tujh ko hukm de chuka. Kehne laga main is se behtar hoon, aap ne mujh ko aag se paida kiya hai aur is ko aap ne khaak se paida kiya hai.
ayahs.13: Haq Taala ne farmaya aasman se utar, tujh ko koi haq haasil nahi ke tu aasman mein reh kar takabbur kare, so nikal be-shak tu zaleelon mein se hai.
ayahs.14: Us ne kaha ke mujh ko mohlat dijiye qayamat ke din tak.
ayahs.15: Allah Taala ne farmaya tujh ko mohlat di gayi.
ayahs.16: Us ne kaha ba-sabab is ke ke aap ne mujh ko gumraah kiya hai main qasam khaata hoon ke main un ke liye aap ki seedhi raah par baithoonga.
ayahs.17: Phir un par hamla karoonga un ke aage se bhi aur un ke peechhe se bhi aur un ki daahni jaanib se bhi aur un ki baayen jaanib se bhi aur aap un mein se aksar ko shukr-guzaar na paayenge.
ayahs.18: Allah Taala ne farmaya ke yahaan se zaleel-o-khwaar hokar nikal ja, jo shakhs un mein se tera kehna maanega main zaroor tum sab se jahannam ko bhar doonga.
ayahs.19: Aur hum ne hukm diya ke aye Aadam! Tum aur tumhari biwi jannat mein raho. Phir jis jagah se chaaho dono khaao, aur is darakht ke paas mat jaao warna tum dono zaalimon mein se hojaaoge.
ayahs.20: Phir shaitaan ne un dono ke dilon mein waswasa daala taake un ki sharmgahen jo ek doosre se posheeda thin dono ke rubaroo be-parda karde aur kehne laga ke tumhare Rabb ne tum dono ko is darakht se aur kisi sabab se mana nahi farmaya, magar mahaz is wajah se ke tum dono kahin farishte hojaao ya kahin hamesha zinda rehne walon mein se hojaao.
ayahs.21: Aur un dono ke rubaroo qasam kha li ke yaqeen jaaniye main tum dono ka khairkhwah hoon.
ayahs.22: So un dono ko fareb se neeche le aaya. Pas un dono ne jab darakht ko chakkha dono ki sharmgahen ek doosre ke rubaroo be-parda hogayin aur dono apne oopar jannat ke patte jod jod kar rakhne lage aur un ke Rabb ne un ko pukaara kya main tum dono ko is darakht se mana na kar chuka tha aur yeh na keh chuka ke shaitaan tumhara sareeh dushman hai?
ayahs.23: Dono ne kaha aye hamare Rabb! Hum ne apna bada nuqsaan kiya aur agar tu hamari maghfirat na karega aur hum par reham na karega to waqai hum nuqsaan paane walon mein se hojaayenge.
ayahs.24: Haq Taala ne farmaya ke neeche aisi haalat mein jaao ke tum baaham ek doosre ke dushman hoge aur tumhare waaste zameen mein rehne ki jagah hai aur nafa haasil karna hai ek waqt tak.
ayahs.25: Farmaya tum ko wahaan hi zindagi basar karna hai aur wahaan hi marna hai aur isi mein se phir nikaale jaaoge.
ayahs.26: Aye Aadam (alaihis salaam) ki aulaad hum ne tumhare liye libaas paida kiya jo tumhari sharmgahon ko bhi chhupaata hai aur moojib-e-zeenat bhi hai aur taqwe ka libaas, yeh is se badh kar hai. Yeh Allah Taala ki nishaaniyon mein se hai taake yeh log yaad rakhen.
ayahs.27: Aye aulaad-e-Aadam! Shaitaan tum ko kisi kharaabi mein na daal de jaisa us ne tumhare maa baap ko jannat se baahar kara diya aisi haalat mein un ka libaas bhi utrwa diya taake woh un ko un ki sharmgahen dikhaaye. Woh aur us ka lashkar tum ko aise taur par dekhta hai ke tum un ko nahi dekhte ho. Hum ne shaitaanon ko un hi logon ka dost banaya hai jo imaan nahi laate.
ayahs.28: Aur woh log jab koi fahash kaam karte hain to kehte hain ke hum ne apne baap dada ko isi tareeq par paaya hai aur Allah ne bhi hum ko yahi bataya hai. Aap keh dijiye ke Allah Taala fahash baat ki taaleem nahi deta, kya Allah ke zimme aisi baat lagaate ho jis ki tum sanad nahi rakhte?
ayahs.29: Aap keh dijiye ke mere Rabb ne hukm diya hai insaaf ka aur yeh ke tum har sajda ke waqt apna rukh seedha rakha karo aur Allah Taala ki ibaadat is taur par karo ke is ibaadat ko khaalis Allah hi ke waaste rakho. Tum ko Allah ne jis tarah shuroo mein paida kiya tha isi tarah tum dobara paida hoge.
ayahs.30: Baaz logon ko Allah ne hidayat di hai aur baaz par gumraahi saabit hogayi hai. Un logon ne Allah Taala ko chhod kar shaitaanon ko dost bana liya hai aur khayaal rakhte hain ke woh raast par hain.
ayahs.31: Aye aulaad-e-Aadam! Tum masjid ki har haazri ke waqt apna libaas pehan liya karo. Aur khoob khaao aur piyo aur hadd se mat niklo. Be-shak Allah hadd se nikal jaane walon ko pasand nahi karta.
ayahs.32: Aap farmaiye ke Allah Taala ke paida kiye hue asbaab-e-zeenat ko, jin ko us ne apne bandon ke waaste banaya hai aur khaane peene ki halaal cheezon ko kis shakhs ne haraam kiya hai? Aap keh dijiye ke yeh ashya is taur par ke qayamat ke roz khaalis hongi ahl-e-imaan ke liye, dunyavi zindagi mein mominon ke liye bhi hain. Hum isi tarah tamaam aayaat ko samajhdaaron ke waaste saaf saaf bayaan karte hain.
ayahs.33: Aap farmaiye ke albatta mere Rabb ne sirf haraam kiya hai un tamaam fahash baaton ko jo alaaniya hain aur jo posheeda hain aur har gunaah ki baat ko aur naahaq kisi par zulm karne ko aur is baat ko ke tum Allah ke saath kisi aisi cheez ko shareek thahraao jis ki Allah ne koi sanad naazil nahi ki aur is baat ko ke tum log Allah ke zimme aisi baat laga do jis ko tum jaante nahi.
ayahs.34: Aur har giroh ke liye ek miyaad muayyan hai so jis waqt un ki miyaad muayyan aa jaayegi is waqt ek saat na peechhe hat sakenge aur na aage badh sakenge.
ayahs.35: Aye aulaad-e-Aadam! Agar tumhare paas paighambar aayen jo tum hi mein se hon jo mere ahkaam tum se bayaan karen to jo shakhs taqwa ikhtiyaar kare aur durusti kare so un logon par na kuch andesha hai aur na woh ghamgeen honge.
ayahs.36: Aur jo log hamare un ahkaam ko jhutlaayen aur un se takabbur karen woh log dozakh wale honge woh is mein hamesha hamesha rahenge.
ayahs.37: So is shakhs se ziyaada zaalim kaun hoga jo Allah Taala par jhoot baandhe ya us ki aayaton ko jhoota bataaye, un logon ke naseeb ka jo kuch kitaab se hai woh un ko mil jaayega, yahaan tak ke jab un ke paas hamare bheje hue farishte un ki jaan qabz karne aayenge to kahenge ke woh kahaan gaye jin ki tum Allah ko chhod kar ibaadat karte the, woh kahenge ke hum se sab ghaayib hogaye aur apne kaafir hone ka iqraar karenge.
ayahs.38: Allah Taala farmaayega ke jo firqe tum se pehle guzar chuke hain jinnat mein se bhi aur aadmiyon mein se bhi, un ke saath tum bhi dozakh mein jaao. Jis waqt bhi koi jamaat daakhil hogi apni doosri jamaat ko laanat karegi yahaan tak ke jab is mein sab jama hojaayenge to pichhle log pehle logon ki nisbat kahenge ke hamare parwardigaar hum ko un logon ne gumraah kiya tha so un ko dozakh ka azaab dugna de. Allah Taala farmaayega ke sab hi ka dugna hai, lekin tum ko khabar nahi.
ayahs.39: Aur pehle log pichhle logon se kahenge ke phir tum ko hum par koi fauqiyat nahi so tum bhi apni kamaai ke badle mein azaab ka maza chakkho.
ayahs.40: Jin logon ne hamari aayaton ko jhutlaaya aur un se takabbur kiya un ke liye aasman ke darwaaze na khole jaayenge aur woh log kabhi jannat mein na jaayenge jab tak ke oont sooi ke naake ke andar se na chala jaaye aur hum mujrim logon ko aisi hi saza dete hain.
ayahs.41: Un ke liye aatish-e-dozakh ka bichhauna hoga aur un ke oopar (isi ka) odhna hoga aur hum aise zaalimon ko aisi hi saza dete hain.
ayahs.42: Aur jo log imaan laaye aur unhon ne nek kaam kiye, hum kisi shakhs ko us ki qudrat se ziyaada kisi ka mukallaf nahi banaate, wahi log jannat wale hain aur woh us mein hamesha hamesha rahenge.
ayahs.43: Aur jo kuch un ke dilon mein (keena) tha hum us ko door kar denge. Un ke neeche nehren jaari hongi. Aur woh log kahenge ke Allah ka (laakh laakh) shukr hai jis ne hum ko is maqaam tak pahunchaaya aur hamari kabhi rasaai na hoti agar Allah Taala hum ko na pahunchaata. Waaqai hamare Rabb ke paighambar sachchi baaten le kar aaye the. Aur un se pukaar kar kaha jaayega ke is jannat ke tum waaris banaaye gaye ho apne aamaal ke badle.
ayahs.44: Aur ahl-e-jannat ahl-e-dozakh ko pukaarenge ke hum se jo hamare Rabb ne waada farmaaya tha hum ne to us ko waqia ke mutaabiq paaya, so tum se jo tumhare Rabb ne waada kiya tha tum ne bhi us ko waqia ke mutaabiq paaya? Woh kahenge haan, phir ek pukaarne wala dono ke darmiyaan mein pukaarega ke Allah ki maar ho un zaalimon par.
ayahs.45: Jo Allah ki raah se eraaz karte the aur us mein kaji talaash karte the aur woh log aakhirat ke bhi munkir the.
ayahs.46: Aur un dono ke darmiyaan ek aad hogi aur Aaraaf ke oopar bahut se aadmi honge, woh log har ek ko un ke qiyafa se pehchaanenge aur ahl-e-jannat ko pukaar kar kahenge, assalaam alaikum! Abhi yeh ahl-e-Aaraaf jannat mein daakhil nahi hue honge aur us ke umeedvaar honge.
ayahs.47: Aur jab un ki nigaahen ahl-e-dozakh ki taraf phirengi to kahenge aye hamare Rabb! Hum ko un zaalim logon ke saath shaamil na kar.
ayahs.48: Aur ahl-e-Aaraaf bahut se aadmiyon ko jin ko ke un ke qiyafa se pehchaanenge pukaarenge, kahenge ke tumhari jamaat aur tumhara apne ko bada samajhna tumhare kuch kaam na aaya.
ayahs.49: Kya yeh wahi hain jin ki nisbat tum qasmen kha kha kar kaha karte the ke Allah Taala un par rehmat na karega, un ko yun hukm hoga ke jaao jannat mein, tum par na kuch khauf hai aur na tum maghmoom hoge.
ayahs.50: Aur dozakh wale jannat walon ko pukaarenge ke hamare oopar thoda paani hi daal do ya aur hi kuch de do, jo Allah ne tum ko de rakha hai. Jannat wale kahenge ke Allah Taala ne dono cheezon ki kaafiron ke liye bandish kar di hai.
ayahs.51: Jinhon ne dunya mein apne deen ko lahu-o-lab bana rakha tha aur jin ko dunyavi zindagi ne dhoke mein daal rakha tha. So hum (bhi) aaj ke roz un ka naam bhool jaayenge jaisa ke woh is din ko bhool gaye aur jaisa yeh hamari aayaton ka inkaar karte the.
ayahs.52: Aur hum ne un logon ke paas ek aisi kitaab pahuncha di hai jis ko hum ne apne ilm-e-kamil se bahut waazeh kar ke bayaan kar diya hai, woh zariya-e-hidayat aur rehmat un logon ke liye hai jo imaan laaye hain.
ayahs.53: Un logon ko aur kisi baat ka intezaar nahi sirf us ke aakhir nateeja ka intezaar hai. Jis roz us ka aakhir nateeja pesh aayega aur us roz jo log us ko pehle se bhoole hue the yun kahenge ke waaqai hamare Rabb ke paighambar sachchi sachchi baaten laaye the, so ab kya koi hamara sifaarishi hai ke woh hamari sifaarish kar de ya kya hum phir waapas bheje ja sakte hain taake hum log un aamaal ke, jin ko hum kiya karte the, barkhilaaf doosre aamaal karen. Be-shak un logon ne apne aap ko khasaare mein daal diya aur yeh jo jo baaten taraashte the sab gum ho gayin.
ayahs.54: Be-shak tumhara Rabb Allah hi hai jis ne sab aasmanon aur zameen ko chhe roz mein paida kiya hai, phir arsh par qaayam hua. Woh shab se din ko aise taur par chhupa deta hai ke woh shab is din ko jaldi se aa leti hai aur sooraj aur chaand aur doosre sitaaron ko paida kiya aise taur par ke sab us ke hukm ke taabe hain. Yaad rakho Allah hi ke liye khaas hai khaaliq hona aur haakim hona, badi khoobiyon se bhara hua hai Allah jo tamaam aalam ka parwardigaar hai.
ayahs.55: Tum log apne parwardigaar se dua kiya karo gidgida kar ke bhi aur chupke chupke bhi. Waaqai Allah Taala un logon ko na-pasand karta hai jo hadd se nikal jaayen.
ayahs.56: Aur dunya mein is ke baad ke us ki durusti kar di gayi hai, fasaad mat phailaao aur tum Allah ki ibaadat karo us se darte hue aur umeedvaar rehte hue. Be-shak Allah Taala ki rehmat nek kaam karne walon ke nazdeek hai.
ayahs.57: Aur woh aisa hai ke apni baaraan-e-rehmat se pehle hawaaon ko bhejta hai ke woh khush kar deti hain, yahaan tak ke jab woh hawaayen bhaari baadalon ko utha leti hain, to hum is baadal ko kisi khushk sarzameen ki taraf haank le jaate hain, phir is baadal se paani barsaate hain phir is paani se har qism ke phal nikaalte hain. Yun hi hum murdon ko nikaal khada karenge taake tum samjho.
ayahs.58: Aur jo suthri sarzameen hoti hai us ki paidawaar to Allah ke hukm se khoob nikalti hai aur jo kharaab hai us ki paidawaar bahut kam nikalti hai, isi tarah hum dalaail ko tarah tarah se bayaan karte hain, un logon ke liye jo shukr karte hain.
ayahs.59: Hum ne Nooh (alaihis salaam) ko un ki qaum ki taraf bheja to unhon ne farmaaya aye meri qaum! Tum Allah ki ibaadat karo, us ke siwa koi tumhara mabood hone ke qaabil nahi, mujh ko tumhare liye ek bade din ke azaab ka andesha hai.
ayahs.60: Un ki qaum ke bade logon ne kaha ke hum tum ko sareeh ghalti mein dekhte hain.
ayahs.61: Unhon ne farmaaya ke aye meri qaum! Mujh mein to zara bhi gumraahi nahi lekin main parwardigaar-e-aalam ka Rasool hoon.
ayahs.62: Tum ko apne parwardigaar ke paighaam pahunchaata hoon aur tumhari khairkhwahi karta hoon aur main Allah ki taraf se un umoor ki khabar rakhta hoon jin ki tum ko khabar nahi.
ayahs.63: Aur kya tum is baat se taajjub karte ho ke tumhare parwardigaar ki taraf se tumhare paas ek aise shakhs ki maarifat, jo tumhari hi jins ka hai, koi naseehat ki baat aa gayi taake woh shakhs tum ko daraaye aur taake tum dar jaao aur taake tum par reham kiya jaaye.
ayahs.64: So woh log un ki takzeeb hi karte rahe to hum ne Nooh (alaihis salaam) ko aur un ko jo un ke saath kashti mein the, bacha liya aur jin logon ne hamari aayaton ko jhutlaaya tha un ko hum ne gharq kar diya. Be-shak woh log andhe ho rahe the.
ayahs.65: Aur hum ne qaum-e-Aad ki taraf un ke bhai Hood (alaihis salaam) ko bheja. Unhon ne farmaaya aye meri qaum! Tum Allah ki ibaadat karo, us ke siwa koi tumhara mabood nahi, so kya tum nahi darte?
ayahs.66: Un ki qaum mein jo bade log kaafir the unhon ne kaha hum tum ko kam-aqli mein dekhte hain. Aur hum be-shak tum ko jhoote logon mein samajhte hain.
ayahs.67: Unhon ne farmaaya ke aye meri qaum! Mujh mein zara bhi kam-aqli nahi lekin main parwardigaar-e-aalam ka bheja hua paighambar hoon.
ayahs.68: Tum ko apne parwardigaar ke paighaam pahunchaata hoon aur main tumhara amaanatdaar khairkhwah hoon.
ayahs.69: Aur kya tum is baat se taajjub karte ho ke tumhare parwardigaar ki taraf se tumhare paas ek aise shakhs ki maarifat, jo tumhari hi jins ka hai, koi naseehat ki baat aa gayi taake woh shakhs tum ko daraaye aur tum yeh haalat yaad karo ke Allah ne tum ko qaum-e-Nooh ke baad jaanasheen banaaya aur deel-dol mein tum ko phailaao ziyaada diya, so Allah ki nematon ko yaad karo taake tum ko falah ho.
ayahs.70: Unhon ne kaha ke kya aap hamare paas is waaste aaye hain ke hum sirf Allah hi ki ibaadat karen aur jin ko hamare baap dada poojte the un ko chhod den, pas hum ko jis azaab ki dhamki dete ho us ko hamare paas mangwa do agar tum sachche ho.
ayahs.71: Unhon ne farmaaya ke bas ab tum par Allah ki taraf se azaab aur ghazab aaya hi chaahta hai. Kya tum mujh se aise naamon ke baab mein jhagadte ho jin ko tum ne aur tumhare baap dadon ne thahra liya hai? Un ke mabood hone ki Allah ne koi daleel nahi bheji. So tum muntazir raho, main bhi tumhare saath intezaar kar raha hoon.
ayahs.72: Gharaz hum ne un ko aur un ke saathiyon ko apni rehmat se bacha liya aur un logon ki jad kaat di, jinhon ne hamari aayaton ko jhutlaaya tha aur woh imaan laane wale na the.
ayahs.73: Aur hum ne Samood ki taraf un ke bhai Saalih (alaihis salaam) ko bheja. Unhon ne farmaaya aye meri qaum! Tum Allah ki ibaadat karo, us ke siwa koi tumhara mabood nahi. Tumhare paas tumhare parwardigaar ki taraf se ek waazeh daleel aa chuki hai. Yeh oontni hai Allah ki jo tumhare liye daleel hai, so is ko chhod do ke Allah Taala ki zameen mein khaati phire aur is ko buraai ke saath haath bhi mat lagaana ke kahin tum ko dardnaak azaab aa pakde.
ayahs.74: Aur tum yeh haalat yaad karo ke Allah Taala ne tum ko Aad ke baad jaanasheen banaaya aur tum ko zameen par rehne ka thikaana diya ke narm zameen par mahal banaate ho aur pahaadon ko taraash taraash kar un mein ghar banaate ho, so Allah Taala ki nematon ko yaad karo aur zameen mein fasaad mat phailaao.
ayahs.75: Un ki qaum mein jo mutakabbir sardaar the unhon ne ghareeb logon se jo ke un mein se imaan le aaye the poocha, kya tum ko is baat ka yaqeen hai ke Saalih (alaihis salaam) apne Rabb ki taraf se bheje hue hain? Unhon ne kaha ke be-shak hum to us par poora yaqeen rakhte hain jo un ko de kar bheja gaya hai.
ayahs.76: Woh mutakabbir log kehne lage ke tum jis baat par yaqeen laaye hue ho, hum to us ke munkir hain.
ayahs.77: Pas unhon ne is oontni ko maar daala aur apne parwardigaar ke hukm se sarkashi ki aur kehne lage ke aye Saalih! Jis ki aap hum ko dhamki dete the us ko mangwaaiye agar aap paighambar hain.
ayahs.78: Pas un ko zalzala ne aa pakda aur woh apne gharon mein aundhe ke aundhe pade reh gaye.
ayahs.79: Is waqt (Saalih alaihis salaam) un se munh mod kar chale, aur farmaane lage ke aye meri qaum! Main ne to tum ko apne parwardigaar ka hukm pahuncha diya tha aur main ne tumhari khairkhwahi ki lekin tum log khairkhwahon ko pasand nahi karte.
ayahs.80: Aur hum ne Loot (alaihis salaam) ko bheja jabke unhon ne apni qaum se farmaaya ke tum aisa fahash kaam karte ho jis ko tum se pehle kisi ne dunya jahaan walon mein se nahi kiya.
ayahs.81: Tum mardon ke saath shahwat-rani karte ho aurton ko chhod kar, balke tum to hadd hi se guzar gaye ho.
ayahs.82: Aur un ki qaum se koi jawaab na ban pada, bajuz is ke ke aapas mein kehne lage ke in logon ko apni basti se nikaal do. Yeh log bade paak saaf bante hain.
ayahs.83: So hum ne Loot (alaihis salaam) ko aur un ke ghar walon ko bacha liya bajuz un ki biwi ke ke woh un hi logon mein rahi jo azaab mein reh gaye the.
ayahs.84: Aur hum ne un par khaas tarah ka meenh barsaaya pas dekho to sahi in mujrim logon ka anjaam kaisa hua?
ayahs.85: Aur hum ne Madyan ki taraf un ke bhai Shuaib (alaihis salaam) ko bheja. Unhon ne farmaaya aye meri qaum! Tum Allah ki ibaadat karo us ke siwa koi tumhara mabood nahi, tumhare paas tumhare parwardigaar ki taraf se waazeh daleel aa chuki hai. Pas tum naap aur tol poora poora kiya karo aur logon ko un ki cheezen kam karke mat do aur roo-e-zameen mein, is ke baad ke is ki durusti kar di gayi, fasaad mat phailaao, yeh tumhare liye naafe hai agar tum tasdeeq karo.
ayahs.86: Aur tum sadkon par is gharz se mat baitha karo ke Allah par imaan laane wale ko dhamkiyan do aur Allah ki raah se roko aur is mein kaji ki talaash mein lage raho. Aur is haalat ko yaad karo jab ke tum kam the phir Allah ne tum ko ziyaada kar diya aur dekho ke kaisa anjaam hua fasaad karne walon ka.
ayahs.87: Aur agar tum mein se kuch log is hukm par, jis ko de kar mujh ko bheja gaya, imaan le aaye hain aur kuch imaan nahi laaye hain to zara thahar jaao! Yahaan tak ke hamare darmiyaan Allah faisla kiye deta hai aur woh sab faisla karne walon se behtar hai.
ayahs.88: Un ki qaum ke mutakabbir sardaron ne kaha ke aye Shuaib! Hum aap ko aur jo aap ke hamraah imaan wale hain un ko apni basti se nikaal denge illa yeh ke tum hamare mazhab mein phir aa jaao. Shuaib (alaihis salaam) ne jawaab diya ke kya hum tumhare mazhab mein aa jaayen go hum is ko makrooh hi samajhte hon.
ayahs.89: Hum to Allah Taala par badi jhooti tohmat lagaane wale ho jaayenge agar hum tumhare deen mein aa jaayen is ke baad ke Allah Taala ne hum ko is se najat di aur hum se mumkin nahi ke tumhare mazhab mein phir aa jaayen, lekin haan yeh ke Allah hi ne jo hamara maalik hai muqaddar kiya ho. Hamare Rabb ka ilm har cheez ko muheet hai, hum Allah hi par bharosa rakhte hain. Aye hamare parwardigaar! Hamare aur hamari qaum ke darmiyaan haq ke muwafiq faisla kar de aur tu sab se achha faisla karne wala hai.
ayahs.90: Aur un ki qaum ke kaafir sardaron ne kaha ke agar tum Shuaib (alaihis salaam) ki raah par chaloge to be-shak bada nuqsaan uthaaoge.
ayahs.91: Pas un ko zalzale ne aa pakda so woh apne gharon mein aundhe ke aundhe pade reh gaye.
ayahs.92: Jinhon ne Shuaib (alaihis salaam) ki takzeeb ki thi un ki yeh haalat ho gayi jaise in gharon mein kabhi base hi na the. Jinhon ne Shuaib (alaihis salaam) ki takzeeb ki thi wohi khasaare mein pad gaye.
ayahs.93: Is waqt Shuaib (alaihis salaam) un se munh mod kar chale aur farmaane lage ke aye meri qaum! Main ne tum ko apne parwardigaar ke ahkaam pahuncha diye the aur main ne tumhari khair-khwahi ki. Phir main in kaafir logon par kyun ranj karoon.
ayahs.94: Aur hum ne kisi basti mein koi nabi nahi bheja ke wahaan ke rehne walon ko hum ne sakhti aur takleef mein na pakda ho, taake woh gidgidayen.
ayahs.95: Phir hum ne is badhaali ki jagah khush-haali badal di, yahaan tak ke un ko khoob taraqqi hui aur kehne lage ke hamare aaba-o-ajdaad ko bhi tangi aur rahat pesh aayi thi to hum ne un ko daftan pakad liya aur un ko khabar bhi na thi.
ayahs.96: Aur agar in bastiyon ke rehne wale imaan le aate aur parhezgaari ikhtiyaar karte to hum un par aasman aur zameen ki barkaten khol dete lekin unhon ne takzeeb ki to hum ne un ke aamaal ki wajah se un ko pakad liya.
ayahs.97: Kya phir bhi in bastiyon ke rehne wale is baat se be-fikr ho gaye hain ke un par hamara azaab shab ke waqt aa pade jis waqt woh sote hon.
ayahs.98: Aur kya in bastiyon ke rehne wale is baat se be-fikr ho gaye hain ke un par hamara azaab din chadhe aa pade jis waqt ke woh apne khelon mein mashghool hon.
ayahs.99: Kya pas woh Allah ki is pakad se be-fikr ho gaye. So Allah ki pakad se bajuz un ke jin ki shaamat hi aa gayi ho aur koi be-fikr nahi hota.
ayahs.100: Aur kya in logon ko jo zameen ke waaris hue wahaan ke logon ki halaakat ke baad (in waqiaat-e-mazkoora ne) yeh baat nahi batlaayi ke agar hum chaahen to un ke jaraaim ke sabab un ko halaak kar daalen aur hum un ke dilon par band laga den, pas woh na sun saken.
ayahs.101: In bastiyon ke kuch kuch qisse hum aap se bayaan kar rahe hain aur in sab ke paas un ke paighambar mojizaat le kar aaye, phir jis cheez ko unhon ne ibtida mein jhoota keh diya yeh baat na hui ke phir is ko maan lete, Allah Taala isi tarah kaafiron ke dilon par band laga deta hai.
ayahs.102: Aur aksar logon mein hum ne wafa-e-ahd na dekha aur hum ne aksar logon ko be-hukm hi paaya.
ayahs.103: Phir un ke baad hum ne Moosa (alaihis salaam) ko apne dalail de kar Firaun aur us ke umara ke paas bheja, magar in logon ne un ka bilkul haq ada na kiya. So dekhiye in mufsidon ka kya anjaam hua?
ayahs.104: Aur Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne farmaaya ke aye Firaun! Main Rabb-ul-aalameen ki taraf se paighambar hoon.
ayahs.105: Mere liye yahi shayaan hai ke bajuz sach ke Allah ki taraf koi baat mansoob na karoon, main tumhare paas tumhare Rabb ki taraf se ek badi daleel bhi laaya hoon, so tu Bani Israeel ko mere saath bhej de.
ayahs.106: Firaun ne kaha, agar aap koi mojiza le kar aaye hain to is ko ab pesh kijiye! Agar aap sachche hain.
ayahs.107: Pas aap ne apna asa daal diya, so daftan woh saaf ek azhdaha ban gaya.
ayahs.108: Aur apna haath baahar nikaala so woh yakayak sab dekhne walon ke roobaru bahut hi chamakta hua ho gaya.
ayahs.109: Qaume Firaun mein jo sardar log the unhon ne kaha ke waaqai yeh shakhs bada maahir jaadugar hai.
ayahs.110: Yeh chaahta hai ke tum ko tumhari sarzameen se baahar kar de so tum log kya mashwara dete ho.
ayahs.111: Unhon ne kaha ke aap in ko aur in ke bhai ko mohlat dijiye aur shehron mein harkaaron ko bhej dijiye.
ayahs.112: Ke woh sab maahir jaadugaron ko aap ke paas la kar haazir kar den.
ayahs.113: Aur woh jaadugar Firaun ke paas haazir hue, kehne lage ke agar hum ghaalib aaye to hum ko koi bada sila milega?
ayahs.114: Firaun ne kaha ke haan aur tum muqarrab logon mein daakhil ho jaaoge.
ayahs.115: In saahiron ne arz kiya ke aye Moosa! Khwah aap daaliye aur ya hum hi daalen?
ayahs.116: (Moosa alaihis salaam) ne farmaaya ke tum hi daalo, pas jab unhon ne daala to logon ki nazar-bandi kar di aur un par haibat ghaalib kar di aur ek tarah ka bada jaadu dikhlaaya.
ayahs.117: Aur hum ne Moosa (alaihis salaam) ko hukm diya ke apna asa daal dijiye! So asa ka daalna tha ke is ne un ke saare bane banaaye khel ko nigalna shuroo kiya.
ayahs.118: Pas haq zaahir ho gaya aur unhon ne jo kuch banaaya tha sab jaata raha.
ayahs.119: Pas woh log is mauqa par haar gaye aur khoob zaleel ho kar phire.
ayahs.120: Aur woh jo saahir the sajde mein gir gaye.
ayahs.121: Kehne lage ke hum imaan laaye Rabb-ul-aalameen par.
ayahs.122: Jo Moosa aur Haaroon ka bhi Rabb hai.
ayahs.123: Firaun kehne laga ke tum Moosa par imaan laaye ho baghair is ke ke main tum ko ijaazat doon? Be-shak yeh saazish thi jis par tumhara amal-daraamad hua hai is shehar mein taake tum sab is shehar se yahaan ke rehne walon ko baahar nikaal do. So ab tum ko haqeeqat maloom hui jaati hai.
ayahs.124: Main tumhare ek taraf ke haath aur doosri taraf ke paon kaatoonga. Phir tum sab ko sooli par latka doonga.
ayahs.125: Unhon ne jawaab diya ke hum (mar kar) apne maalik hi ke paas jaayenge.
ayahs.126: Aur tu ne hum mein kaunsa aib dekha hai bajuz is ke ke hum apne Rabb ke ahkaam par imaan le aaye, jab woh hamare paas aaye. Aye hamare Rabb! Hamare oopar sabr ka faizaan farma aur hamari jaan haalat-e-Islam par nikaal.
ayahs.127: Aur qaum-e-Firaun ke sardaaron ne kaha ke kya aap Moosa (alaihis salaam) aur un ki qaum ko yun hi rehne denge ke woh mulk mein fasaad karte phiren, aur woh aap ko aur aap ke maboodon ko tark kiye rahen. Firaun ne kaha ke hum abhi un logon ke beton ko qatl karna shuru kar denge aur aurton ko zinda rehne denge aur hum ko un par har tarah ka zor hai.
ayahs.128: Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne apni qaum se farmaya Allah Taala ka sahaara haasil karo aur sabr karo, yeh zameen Allah Taala ki hai, apne bandon mein se jis ko chaahe woh maalik bana de aur aakhir kaamyaabi un hi ki hoti hai jo Allah se darte hain.
ayahs.129: Qaum ke log kehne lage ke hum to hamesha museebat hi mein rahe, aap ki tashreef-aawari se qabl bhi aur aap ki tashreef-aawari ke baad bhi. Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne farmaya ke bahut jald Allah tumhare dushman ko halaak kar dega aur bajaaye un ke tum ko is sarzameen ka khaleefa bana dega phir tumhara tarz-e-amal dekhega.
ayahs.130: Aur hum ne Firaun walon ko mubtala kiya qaht-saali mein aur phalon ki kam paidaawaari mein, taake woh naseehat qubool karen.
ayahs.131: So jab un par khushhaali aa jaati to kehte ke yeh to hamare liye hona hi chaahiye aur agar un ko koi badhaali pesh aati to Moosa (alaihis salaam) aur un ke saathiyon ki nahoosat batlaate. Yaad rakho ke un ki nahoosat Allah Taala ke paas hai, lekin un ke aksar log nahi jaante.
ayahs.132: Aur yun kehte kaisi hi baat hamare saamne laao ke un ke zariye se hum par jaadu chalaao jab bhi hum tumhari baat hargiz na maanenge.
ayahs.133: Phir hum ne un par toofaan bheja aur tiddiyan aur ghun ka keeda aur mendak aur khoon, ke yeh sab khule khule mojize the. So woh takabbur karte rahe aur woh log kuch the hi jaraaim-pesha.
ayahs.134: Aur jab un par koi azaab waaqe hota to yun kehte ke aye Moosa! Hamare liye apne Rabb se is baat ki dua kar dijiye! Jis ka us ne aap se ahd kar rakha hai, agar aap is azaab ko hum se hata den to hum zaroor zaroor aap ke kehne se imaan le aayenge aur hum Bani Israeel ko bhi (riha kar ke) aap ke hamraah kar denge.
ayahs.135: Phir jab un se is azaab ko ek khaas waqt tak ke us tak un ko pahunchna tha hata dete, to woh foran hi ahd-shikni karne lagte.
ayahs.136: Phir hum ne un se badla liya yaani un ko darya mein gharq kar diya is sabab se ke woh hamari aayaton ko jhutlaate the aur un se bilkul hi ghaflat karte the.
ayahs.137: Aur hum ne un logon ko jo ke bilkul kamzor shumaar kiye jaate the. Is sarzameen ke poorab pachhim ka maalik bana diya, jis mein hum ne barkat rakhi hai aur aap ke Rabb ka nek waada, Bani Israeel ke haq mein un ke sabr ki wajah se poora ho gaya aur hum ne Firaun ke aur us ki qaum ke saakhta-pardaakhta karkhaanon ko aur jo kuch woh oonchi oonchi imaaraten banwaate the, sab ko darham-barham kar diya.
ayahs.138: Aur hum ne Bani Israeel ko darya se paar utaar diya. Pas un logon ka ek qaum par guzar hua jo apne chand buton se lage baithe the, kehne lage aye Moosa! Hamare liye bhi ek mabood aisa hi muqarrar kar dijiye! Jaise un ke yeh mabood hain. Aap ne farmaya ke waaqai tum logon mein badi jahaalat hai.
ayahs.139: Yeh log jis kaam mein lage hain yeh tabaah kiya jaayega aur un ka yeh kaam mehaz be-buniyaad hai.
ayahs.140: Farmaya kya Allah Taala ke siwa aur kisi ko tumhara mabood tajweez kar doon? Haalaanke us ne tum ko tamaam jahaan walon par fauqiyat di hai.
ayahs.141: Aur woh waqt yaad karo jab hum ne tum ko Firaun walon se bacha liya jo tum ko badi sakht takleefen pahunchaate the. Tumhare beton ko qatl kar daalte the aur tumhari aurton ko zinda chhod dete the aur is mein tumhare Parwardigaar ki taraf se badi bhaari aazmaish thi.
ayahs.142: Aur hum ne Moosa (alaihis salaam) se tees raaton ka waada kiya aur das raat mazeed se un tees raaton ko poora kiya. So un ke Parwardigaar ka waqt poore chaalees raat ka ho gaya. Aur Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne apne bhai Haaroon (alaihis salaam) se kaha ke mere baad un ka intizaam rakhna aur islaah karte rehna aur bad-nazm logon ki raaye par amal mat karna.
ayahs.143: Aur jab Moosa (alaihis salaam) hamare waqt par aaye aur un ke Rabb ne un se baaten keen to arz kiya ke aye mere Parwardigaar! Apna deedaar mujh ko kara dijiye ke main aap ko ek nazar dekh loon. Irshaad hua ke tum mujh ko hargiz nahi dekh sakte lekin tum is pahaad ki taraf dekhte raho woh agar apni jagah par barqaraar raha to tum bhi mujhe dekh sakoge. Pas jab un ke Rabb ne pahaad par tajalli farmaayi to tajalli ne us ke purkhache uda diye aur Moosa (alaihis salaam) be-hosh ho kar gir pade. Phir jab hosh mein aaye to arz kiya, be-shak aap ki zaat munazza hai main aap ki janaab mein tauba karta hoon aur main sab se pehle aap par imaan laane wala hoon.
ayahs.144: Irshaad hua ke aye Moosa! Main ne paighambari aur apni humkalaami se aur logon par tum ko imtiyaaz diya hai to jo kuch tum ko main ne ata kiya hai us ko lo aur shukr karo.
ayahs.145: Aur hum ne chand takhtiyon par har qism ki naseehat aur har cheez ki tafseel un ko likh kar di, tum un ko poori taaqat se pakad lo aur apni qaum ko hukm karo ke un ke achhe achhe ahkaam par amal karen, ab bahut jald tum logon ko un be-hukmon ka maqaam dikhlaata hoon.
ayahs.146: Main aise logon ko apne ahkaam se bargashta hi rakhoonga jo dunya mein takabbur karte hain, jis ka un ko koi haq haasil nahi aur agar tamaam nishaaniyaan dekh len tab bhi woh un par imaan na laayen, aur agar hidayat ka raasta dekhen to us ko apna tareeqa na banaayen aur agar gumraahi ka raasta dekh len to us ko apna tareeqa bana len. Yeh is sabab se hai ke unhon ne hamari aayaton ko jhutlaaya aur un se ghaafil rahe.
ayahs.147: Aur yeh log jinhon ne hamari aayaton ko aur qayamat ke pesh aane ko jhutlaaya un ke sab kaam ghaarat gaye. Un ko wahi saza di jaayegi jo kuch yeh karte the.
ayahs.148: Aur Moosa (alaihis salaam) ki qaum ne un ke baad apne zewaron ka ek bachhra mabood thahra liya jo ke ek qaalib tha jis mein ek aawaaz thi. Kya unhon ne yeh na dekha ke woh un se baat nahi karta tha aur na un ko koi raah batlaata tha us ko unhon ne mabood qaraar diya aur badi be-insaafi ka kaam kiya.
ayahs.149: Aur jab naadim hue aur maloom hua ke waaqai woh log gumraahi mein pad gaye to kehne lage ke agar hamara Rabb hum par reham na kare aur hamara gunaah maaf na kare to hum bilkul gaye guzre ho jaayenge.
ayahs.150: Aur jab Moosa (alaihis salaam) apni qaum ki taraf waapas aaye ghussa aur ranj mein bhare hue to farmaya ke tum ne mere baad yeh badi buri jaanasheeni ki? Kya apne Rabb ke hukm se pehle hi tum ne jaldbaazi kar li, aur jaldi se takhtiyan ek taraf rakhen aur apne bhai ka sar pakad kar un ko apni taraf ghaseetne lage. Haaroon (alaihis salaam) ne kaha ke aye mere maan-jaaye! In logon ne mujh ko be-haqeeqat samjha aur qareeb tha ke mujh ko qatl kar daalen to tum mujh par dushmanon ko mat hansao aur mujh ko un zaalimon ke zail mein mat shumaar karo.
ayahs.151: Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne kaha ke aye mere Rabb! Meri khata maaf farma aur mere bhai ki bhi aur hum dono ko apni rehmat mein daakhil farma aur tu sab reham karne walon se ziyaada reham karne wala hai.
ayahs.152: Be-shak jin logon ne gosaala-parasti ki hai un par bahut jald un ke Rabb ki taraf se ghazab aur zillat is dunyavi zindagi hi mein padegi aur hum iftira-pardaazon ko aisi hi saza diya karte hain.
ayahs.153: Aur jin logon ne gunaah ke kaam kiye phir woh un ke baad tauba kar len aur imaan le aayen to tumhara Rabb is tauba ke baad gunaah maaf kar dene wala, rehmat karne wala hai.
ayahs.154: Aur jab Moosa (alaihis salaam) ka ghussa sard hua to un takhtiyon ko utha liya aur un ke mazaameen mein un logon ke liye jo apne Rabb se darte the hidayat aur rehmat thi.
ayahs.155: Aur Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne sattar aadmi apni qaum mein se hamare waqt-e-muayyan ke liye muntakhab kiye, so jab un ko zalzala ne aa pakda to Moosa (alaihis salaam) arz karne lage ke aye mere Parwardigaar! Agar tujh ko yeh manzoor hota to is se qabl hi un ko aur mujh ko halaak kar deta. Kya tu hum mein se chand be-waqoofon ki harkat par sab ko halaak kar dega? Yeh waaqia mehaz teri taraf se ek imtihaan hai, aise imtihaanaat se jis ko tu chaahe gumraahi mein daal de aur jis ko chaahe hidayat par qaaim rakhe. Tu hi to hamara karsaz hai pas hum par maghfirat aur rehmat farma aur tu sab maafi dene walon se ziyaada achha hai.
ayahs.156: Aur hum logon ke naam dunya mein bhi nek-haali likh de aur aakhirat mein bhi, hum teri taraf ruju karte hain. Allah Taala ne farmaya ke main apna azaab usi par waaqe karta hoon jis par chaahta hoon aur meri rehmat tamaam ashya par muheet hai. To woh rehmat un logon ke naam zaroor likhoonga jo Allah se darte hain aur zakaat dete hain aur jo hamari aayaton par imaan laate hain.
ayahs.157: Jo log aise Rasool nabi ummi ka ittibaa karte hain jin ko woh log apne paas Taurat-o-Injeel mein likha hua paate hain. Woh un ko nek baaton ka hukm farmaate hain aur buri baaton se mana karte hain aur paakeeza cheezon ko halaal batlaate hain aur gandi cheezon ko un par haraam farmaate hain aur un logon par jo bojh aur tauq the un ko door karte hain. So jo log is nabi par imaan laate hain aur un ki himaayat karte hain aur un ki madad karte hain aur is noor ka ittibaa karte hain jo un ke saath bheja gaya hai, aise log poori falah paane wale hain.
ayahs.158: Aap keh dijiye ke aye logo! Main tum sab ki taraf is Allah Taala ka bheja hua hoon, jis ki baadshaahi tamaam aasmanon aur zameen mein hai us ke siwa koi ibaadat ke laaiq nahi wahi zindagi deta hai aur wahi maut deta hai so Allah Taala par imaan laao aur us ke nabi ummi par jo ke Allah Taala par aur us ke ahkaam par imaan rakhte hain aur un ka ittibaa karo taake tum raah par aa jaao.
ayahs.159: Aur qaum-e-Moosa mein ek jamaat aisi bhi hai jo haq ke mutaabiq hidayat karti hai aur isi ke mutaabiq insaaf bhi karti hai.
ayahs.160: Aur hum ne un ko baarah khaandaanon mein taqseem karke sab ki alag alag jamaat muqarrar kar di aur hum ne Moosa (alaihis salaam) ko hukm diya jab ke un ki qaum ne un se paani maanga ke apne asa ko falaan patthar par maaro pas foran is se baarah chashme phoot nikle. Har har shakhs ne apne paani peene ka mauqa maloom kar liya. Aur hum ne un par abr ko saaya-fagan kiya aur un ko mann-o-salwa (taranjabeen aur bateren) pahunchaayen, khaao nafees cheezon se jo ke hum ne tum ko di hain aur unhon ne hamara koi nuqsaan nahi kiya lekin apna hi nuqsaan karte the.
ayahs.161: Aur jab un ko hukm diya gaya ke tum log is abadi mein ja kar raho aur khao is se jis jagah tum raghbat karo aur zaban se yeh kehte jana ke tauba hai aur jhuke jhuke darwaze mein dakhil hona hum tumhari khatayen maaf kar denge. Jo log nek kaam karenge un ko mazeed bar-aan aur denge.
ayahs.162: So badal dala un zaalimon ne ek aur kalima jo khilaf tha us kalime ke jis ki un se farmaish ki gayi thi, is par hum ne un par ek aafat-e-samawi bheji is wajah se ke woh hukm ko zaya karte the.
ayahs.163: Aur aap un logon se, is basti walon ka jo ke darya-e-(shor) ke qareeb abad the is waqt ka haal poochhiye! Jab ke woh hafta ke bare mein had se nikal rahe the jab ke un ke hafta ke roz to un ki machhliyan zahir ho ho kar un ke samne aati thin, aur jab hafta ka din na hota to un ke samne na aati thin, hum un ki is tarah par aazmaish karte the is sabab se ke woh be-hukmi kiya karte the.
ayahs.164: Aur jab ke un mein se ek jamaat ne yun kaha ke tum aise logon ko kyun naseehat karte ho jin ko Allah bilkul halak karne wala hai ya un ko sakht saza dene wala hai? Unhon ne jawab diya ke tumhare Rab ke roo-ba-roo uzr karne ke liye aur is liye ke shayad yeh dar jayen.
ayahs.165: So jab woh us ko bhool gaye jo un ko samjhaya jata tha to hum ne un logon ko to bacha liya jo is buri aadat se mana kiya karte the aur un logon ko jo ke ziyadati karte the ek sakht azaab mein pakad liya is wajah se ke woh be-hukmi kiya karte the.
ayahs.166: Yaani jab woh, jis kaam se un ko mana kiya gaya tha us mein had se nikal gaye to hum ne un ko keh diya tum zaleel bandar ban jao.
ayahs.167: Aur woh waqt yaad karna chahiye ke aap ke Rab ne yeh baat batla di ke woh un yahood par qayamat tak aise shakhs ko zaroor musallat karta rahega jo un ko saza-e-shadeed ki takleef pahunchata rahega, bila-shubha aap ka Rab jaldi hi saza de deta hai aur bila-shubha woh waqai badi maghfirat aur badi rahmat wala hai.
ayahs.168: Aur hum ne duniya mein un ki mukhtalif jamaaten kar din. Baaz un mein nek the aur baaz un mein aur tarah the aur hum un ko khush-haliyon aur bad-haliyon se aazmate rahe ke shayad baz aa jayen.
ayahs.169: Phir un ke baad aise log un ke janasheen hue ke kitab ko un se hasil kiya woh is duniya-e-fani ka maal-o-mata le lete hain aur kehte hain ke hamari zaroor maghfirat ho jayegi halanke agar un ke paas waisa hi maal-o-mata aane lage to is ko bhi le lenge. Kya un se is kitab ke is mazmoon ka ahd nahin liya gaya ke Allah ki taraf bajuz haq baat ke aur kisi baat ki nisbat na karen, aur unhon ne is kitab mein jo kuch tha us ko padh liya aur aakhirat wala ghar un logon ke liye behtar hai jo taqwa rakhte hain, phir kya tum nahin samajhte.
ayahs.170: Aur jo log kitab ke paband hain aur namaz ki pabandi karte hain, hum aise logon ka jo apni islah karen sawab zaya na karenge.
ayahs.171: Aur woh waqt bhi qabil-e-zikr hai jab hum ne pahad ko utha kar saiban ki tarah un ke oopar muallaq kar diya aur un ko yaqeen ho gaya ke ab un par gira aur kaha ke jo kitab hum ne tum ko di hai ise mazbooti ke saath qabool karo aur yaad rakho jo ahkam is mein hain is se tawaqqu hai ke tum muttaqi ban jao.
ayahs.172: Aur jab aap ke Rab ne aulaad-e-Adam ki pusht se un ki aulaad ko nikala aur un se un hi ke mutalliq iqrar liya ke kya main tumhara Rab nahin hoon? Sab ne jawab diya kyun nahin! Hum sab gawah bante hain. Taake tum log qayamat ke roz yun na kaho ke hum to is se mehaz be-khabar the.
ayahs.173: Ya yun kaho ke pehle pehle shirk to hamare badon ne kiya aur hum un ke baad un ki nasal mein hue, so kya un ghalat raah walon ke feil par to hum ko halakat mein daal dega?
ayahs.174: Hum isi tarah ayaat ko saaf saaf bayan karte hain aur taake woh baz aa jayen.
ayahs.175: Aur un logon ko is shakhs ka haal padh kar sunaiye ke jis ko hum ne apni aayaten din phir woh un se bilkul hi nikal gaya, phir shaitan us ke peechhe lag gaya so woh gumrah logon mein shamil ho gaya.
ayahs.176: Aur agar hum chahte to us ko un aayaton ki badaulat buland martaba kar dete lekin woh to duniya ki taraf mail ho gaya aur apni nafsani khwahish ki pairawi karne laga so us ki halat kutte ki si ho gayi ke agar to us par hamla kare tab bhi hanpe ya us ko chhod de tab bhi hanpe, yahi halat un logon ki hai jinhon ne hamari aayaton ko jhutlaya. So aap is haal ko bayan kar dijiye shayad woh log kuch sochen.
ayahs.177: Un logon ki halat bhi buri halat hai jo hamari ayaat ko jhutlate hain aur woh apna nuqsan karte hain.
ayahs.178: Jis ko Allah hidayat karta hai so hidayat pane wala wahi hota hai aur jis ko woh gumrah kar de so aise hi log khasare mein padne wale hain.
ayahs.179: Aur hum ne aise bahut se jinn aur insan dozakh ke liye paida kiye hain, jin ke dil aise hain jin se nahin samajhte aur jin ki aankhen aisi hain jin se nahin dekhte aur jin ke kaan aise hain jin se nahin sunte. Yeh log chopayon ki tarah hain balke yeh un se bhi zyada gumrah hain. Yahi log ghafil hain.
ayahs.180: Aur achchhe achchhe naam Allah hi ke liye hain so un naamon se Allah hi ko mausoom kiya karo aur aise logon se talluq bhi na rakho jo us ke naamon mein kaj-rawi karte hain, un logon ko un ke kiye ki zaroor saza milegi.
ayahs.181: Aur hamari makhlooq mein ek jamaat aisi bhi hai jo haq ke mutabiq hidayat karti hai aur us ke mutabiq insaf bhi karti hai.
ayahs.182: Aur jo log hamari ayaat ko jhutlate hain hum un ko batadreej (giraft mein) liye ja rahe hain is taur par ke un ko khabar bhi nahin.
ayahs.183: Aur un ko mohlat deta hoon be-shak meri tadbeer badi mazboot hai.
ayahs.184: Kya un logon ne is baat par ghaur na kiya ke un ke saathi ko zara bhi junoon nahin woh to sirf ek saaf saaf darane wale hain.
ayahs.185: Aur kya un logon ne ghaur nahin kiya aasmanon aur zameen ke alam mein aur doosri cheezon mein jo Allah ne paida ki hain aur is baat mein ke mumkin hai ke un ki ajal qareeb hi aa pahunchi ho. Phir Quran ke baad kaun si baat par yeh log iman layenge?
ayahs.186: Jis ko Allah Taala gumrah kar de us ko koi raah par nahin la sakta. Aur Allah Taala un ko un ki gumrahi mein bhatakte hue chhod deta hai.
ayahs.187: Yeh log aap se qayamat ke mutalliq sawal karte hain ke is ka wuqoo kab hoga? Aap farma dijiye ke is ka ilm sirf mere Rab hi ke paas hai, is ke waqt par is ko siwa Allah ke koi aur zahir na karega. Woh aasmanon aur zameen mein bada bhari (hadsa) hoga woh tum par mehaz achanak aa padegi. Woh aap se is tarah poochhte hain jaise goya aap is ki tahqeeqat kar chuke hain. Aap farma dijiye ke is ka ilm khas Allah hi ke paas hai lekin aksar log nahin jante.
ayahs.188: Aap farma dijiye ke main khud apni zaat-e-khas ke liye kisi nafa ka ikhtiyar nahin rakhta aur na kisi zarar ka, magar itna hi ke jitna Allah ne chaha ho aur agar main ghaib ki baten janta hota to main bahut se manafe hasil kar leta aur koi nuqsan mujh ko na pahunchta main to mehaz darane wala aur basharat dene wala hoon un logon ko jo iman rakhte hain.
ayahs.189: Woh Allah Taala aisa hai jis ne tum ko ek tan-e-wahid se paida kiya aur isi se is ka joda banaya taake woh is apne jode se uns hasil kare phir jab miyan ne biwi se qurbat ki to us ko hamal reh gaya halka sa. So woh us ko liye hue chalti phirti rahi, phir jab woh bojhal ho gayi to donon miyan biwi Allah se jo un ka Malik hai dua karne lage ke agar tu ne hum ko saheeh salim aulaad de di to hum khoob shukar guzari karenge.
ayahs.190: So jab Allah ne donon ko saheeh salim aulaad de di to Allah ki di hui cheez mein woh donon Allah ke shareek qarar dene lage, so Allah pak hai un ke shirk se.
ayahs.191: Kya aison ko shareek thehrate hain jo kisi cheez ko paida na kar saken aur woh khud hi paida kiye gaye hon.
ayahs.192: Aur woh un ko kisi qism ki madad nahin de sakte aur woh khud bhi madad nahin kar sakte.
ayahs.193: Aur agar tum un ko koi baat batlaane ko pukaro to tumhare kehne par na chalen tumhare aitibar se donon amr barabar hain khwah tum un ko pukaro ya tum khamosh raho.
ayahs.194: Waqai tum Allah ko chhod kar jin ki ibaadat karte ho woh bhi tum hi jaise bande hain so tum un ko pukaro phir un ko chahiye ke tumhara kehna kar den agar tum sachche ho.
ayahs.195: Kya un ke paon hain jin se woh chalte hon ya un ke haath hain jin se woh kisi cheez ko thaam saken, ya un ki aankhen hain jin se woh dekhte hon, ya un ke kaan hain jin se woh sunte hain aap keh dijiye! Tum apne sab shuraka ko bula lo, phir meri zarar-rasani ki tadbeer karo phir mujh ko zara mohlat mat do.
ayahs.196: Yaqeenan mera madadgar Allah Taala hai jis ne yeh kitab nazil farmai aur woh nek bandon ki madad karta hai.
ayahs.197: Aur tum jin logon ki Allah ko chhod kar ibaadat karte ho woh tumhari kuch madad nahin kar sakte aur na woh apni madad kar sakte hain.
ayahs.198: Aur un ko agar koi baat batlaane ko pukaro to is ko na sunen aur un ko aap dekhte hain ke goya woh aap ko dekh rahe hain aur woh kuch bhi nahin dekhte.
ayahs.199: Aap darguzar ko ikhtiyar karen nek kaam ki taleem den aur jahilon se ek kinara ho jayen.
ayahs.200: Aur agar aap ko koi waswasa shaitan ki taraf se aane lage to Allah ki panah maang liya kijiye bila-shubha woh khoob sunne wala khoob jaanne wala hai.
ayahs.201: Yaqeenan jo log Khuda-tars hain jab un ko koi khatra shaitan ki taraf se aa jata hai to woh yaad mein lag jate hain, so yakayak un ki aankhen khul jati hain.
ayahs.202: Aur jo shayateen ke tabe hain woh un ko gumrahi mein kheenche le jate hain pas woh baz nahin aate.
ayahs.203: Aur jab aap koi mojiza un ke samne zahir nahin karte to woh log kehte hain ke aap yeh mojiza kyun na laye? Aap farma dijiye! Ke main is ka ittiba karta hoon jo mujh par mere Rab ki taraf se hukm bheja gaya hai yeh goya bahut si daleelen hain tumhare Rab ki taraf se aur hidayat aur rahmat hai un logon ke liye jo iman rakhte hain.
ayahs.204: Aur jab Quran padha jaya kare to is ki taraf kaan laga diya karo aur khamosh raha karo umeed hai ke tum par rahmat ho.
ayahs.205: Aur (ae Paighambar) apne Rab ki yaad kiya kar apne dil mein aajizi ke saath aur khauf ke saath aur zor ki awaz ki nisbat kam awaz ke saath subah aur shaam aur ahl-e-ghaflat mein se mat hona.
ayahs.206: Yaqeenan jo tere Rab ke nazdeek hain woh is ki ibaadat se takabbur nahin karte aur is ki paki bayan karte hain aur is ko sajda karte hain.
